evidence_tree.isolation: Only data/** and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff, and git history were never opened.

sources.locator: item 3877 (Bloodsong) -> passives[0] (name "Spellblade", unique) -> branches[0]; raw line at data/items.json:83147
sources.quote: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).
sources.why: The only damage-multiplying number Bloodsong contributes. 'increased damage from all sources' makes it a target-side amplifier that scales every damage instance landed on the debuffed target during the 4 s window, including damage from other roster members.

sources.locator: Template argument-order calibration for {{rd|melee|ranged}} — items 3077 (Tiamat), 3074 (Ravenous Hydra), 6631 (Stridebreaker), 6698 (Profane Hydra), passive "Cleave"
sources.quote: Basic attacks [[on-hit]] deal {{as|{{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}|ad}} {{as|physical damage}} to other enemies in a ... 350 radius centered around the target.
sources.why: Cleave's published values are 40% total AD for melee holders and 20% for ranged holders. Because the cache renders those exact numbers as {{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}, the template's first argument is the MELEE value and the second is the RANGED value. Applying that to S1: Expose Weakness = 8% (melee Bloodsong holder) / 5% (ranged holder).

sources.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
sources.why: Negative control. The scenario's other named item is purely an ARMOR-REDUCTION effect. Per docs/math-foundations.md Sections 2.1-2.2, armor only enters through m(R) = 100/(100+R), which acts on post-mitigation damage. Black Cleaver therefore cannot move a raw_damage (pre-mitigation) leaf at all, so it is excluded as the cause of this delta.

sources.quote: m(R) = 100 / (100 + R)          (apply_resistance, resistance.py)   ...   post = raw . m(R)
sources.why: Establishes that raw_damage is the pre-mitigation quantity and that resistance/penetration/reduction act strictly downstream of it. Any change to raw_damage must come from a term on the damage-formation side (base/scaling/amplifier), not from armor math.

sources.quote: grant you 8% increased damage against champions until 5 seconds after exiting combat with them  /  "damage_amp_ratio": 0.08
sources.why: Cross-check on the magnitude. The only other 8% amplifier reachable from the cache is the Press the Attack keystone, and it is also exactly 8%. Both candidate sources agree on the multiplier, so the computed target value is robust to which of them the scenario intends. (Bloodsong is the one named in the scenario id.)

step_1_identify_the_delta.note: Both golden values are stored to 1 decimal place, so the true multiplier is only pinned to an interval.

step_2_rounding_interval.reasoning: old displayed 94.1 => unrounded old in [94.05, 94.15); new displayed 101.7 => unrounded new in [101.65, 101.75).
step_2_rounding_interval.conclusion: 1.08 lies inside the interval; 1.05 and 1.07 do not. The only clean amplifier consistent with the observed pair is exactly +8%.

step_3_forward_check.formula: raw_amped = raw_base x (1 + expose_weakness_ratio),  expose_weakness_ratio = 0.08 (melee holder, S1 + S2)
step_3_forward_check.self_consistent_preimage_window: unrounded raw_base in [94.1204, 94.15) yields displayed old 94.1 AND displayed new 101.7 under 1-dp rounding (window width 0.0296 inside the 0.1-wide old-value bucket)
step_3_forward_check.conclusion: 101.7 is exactly reproducible as the 8% Expose Weakness amplification of the pre-change raw damage; the 0.072 gap versus the naive 94.1 x 1.08 = 101.628 is entirely accounted for by the old value itself being a rounded display of a raw base near 94.13.

step_4_falsify_the_alternatives.result: rejected — 98.8 matches neither stored value; it is outside the admissible multiplier interval by a wide margin

step_4_falsify_the_alternatives.hypothesis: Black Cleaver Carve (up to 30% armor reduction) moved the leaf
step_4_falsify_the_alternatives.result: rejected — Carve is armor reduction (S3); by S4 it acts only through m(R) on post-mitigation damage and is structurally incapable of changing raw_damage

step_4_falsify_the_alternatives.hypothesis: old value was the correct one (no amplifier on this event)
step_4_falsify_the_alternatives.result: rejected — S1 states the debuff causes the target to take increased damage 'from all sources' for 4 s. An unamplified damage instance landing on an Expose Weakness'd target contradicts the cached wiki text; 94.1 is only correct if the event falls outside the 4 s window, which would then also forbid the 101.7 value, and the observed ratio being exactly the sourced 8% makes coincidence implausible.

verdict_rationale: raw_damage is pre-mitigation (S4), so the delta must come from a damage-formation term, which rules out Black Cleaver's armor reduction (S3). The observed change is a clean multiplicative x1.08 — the admissible multiplier interval implied by 1-dp rounding, [1.07966, 1.08187], contains 1.08 and excludes every other round value. 8% is precisely Bloodsong's Expose Weakness amplifier for a melee holder as quoted from the cache (S1), with the {{rd|melee|ranged}} argument order independently calibrated against Cleave's published 40%/20% split (S2), and the same 8% magnitude is corroborated by the only other amplifier in the cache (S5). The new value reproduces the sourced formula; the old value corresponds to the amplifier not being applied to this event at all, which contradicts the 'increased damage from all sources' wording.
residual_uncertainty: The golden corpus scenario definition for 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/), so the roster's champions were not observable. The 8% figure is the MELEE Bloodsong holder's value; if the scenario's Bloodsong carrier is a ranged champion the sourced amplifier would be 5% (S1/S2) and the correct leaf would be ~98.8, making both stored values wrong. The observed ratio matching 8% to within rounding is strong evidence the engine applied the melee branch, but this oracle cannot confirm the holder's range type from data/ alone.
Whether event[48] falls inside the 4 s Expose Weakness window is likewise not verifiable from the evidence tree; the verdict assumes it does, which the exact 8% ratio supports.
Both stored values are rounded to 1 decimal place, so the computation pins the multiplier to an interval rather than reconstructing the leaf from first principles digit-for-digit.
notes: No files were committed. Nothing outside data/** and docs/math-foundations.md was read.
